text: This staff report is about a matter that Community Council has delegated authority from City Council to make a final decision. Transportation Services has reviewed the need for pedestrian crossing protection at the intersection of Adelaide Street East and Ontario Street. Based on the assessment undertaken, Transportation Services is recommending the installation of traffic control signals at the east intersection of Adelaide Street East and Ontario Street. The traffic control signals will provide enhanced safety for vulnerable road users.
The Toronto and East York Community Council deferred the Item to the first meeting in the new term of Council.
